newsitem.title: UK: Burton up as results beat expectations.
newsitem.headline: Burton up as results beat expectations.

text.p: Shares in Burton Group Plc rose in early trading on Thursday after the retail group reported better-than-expected results and said it had made an encouraging start to the current year.
The stock was up 3-1/2p at 148-1/2 by 0807 GMT in active trading of 460,000 shares.
"The figures were at the top end of forecasts and we are still positive on the stock," said one senior trader.
The retail group posted a 53.8 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 151.6 million stg in the year ended August 31 and raised its dividend 27.3 percent to 2.8p.
Analysts had expected pre-tax profit of between 139.0 million stg and 149 million and a dividend of between 2.5p and 2.8p.
"This has been a good year for the group," said Chairman Sir John Hoskyns. "The group has made an encouraging start to the current year."
